name: das Schnitzerl
kurzbeschreibung:
**

Indulge in the classic Schnitzerl—a crispy, golden-brown veal or pork cutlet—right in the heart of Innsbruck. Whether you savor it at a traditional Gasthaus or a cozy mountain inn, this timeless dish is a must-try for meat lovers. Pair it with a local Grüner Veltliner or a refreshing Apfelschorle for the perfect alpine dining experience.
